projects.title: Environmental Time-Series Forecasting
bullets: Identified missing observations in public rainfall measurement series during a supervised undergraduate independent study on environmental time-series forecasting.
Implemented a seasonal forecasting baseline for the rainfall series using Python, pandas, and scikit-learn within the supervised project.

projects.title: Transportation Graph Path Search
bullets: Implemented shortest-path queries on public multimodal transit networks using Python and NetworkX as part of a supervised graduate course project.
Tested disconnected graph cases for path search on the transportation networks as an assigned contribution to the course project.
